text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, please look forward to
our next destination too♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Today, in my own way...
I'm going to make sure Trainer has a wonderful time!

Rhein Kraft led me to
an unfamiliar town a few train stations away from the academy.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "There's so much nature here~! It looks like there's a shopping street a little further up—"
choice_data_list: Looks like a great place for a walk.
Looks like a great place for a walk, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you've already figured it out.
That's right, today's outing is a stroll through an unfamiliar town!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Let's go check it out right away!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It was all greenery just a moment ago...
This area is pretty bustling, huh~

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, it's a Japanese sweets shop!
Would you like to drop by for a bit?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wah, so pretty! Kingyoku jelly...?
Look, there's a goldfish inside the jelly!
choice_data_list: It's so pretty, and it looks delicious!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yokan, daifuku, manju!
Wah, I can't decide. Which one should I...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Wah, that's my favorite—!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, so good~♪
I really do love tri-color dango!
choice_data_list: You really like it that much, huh?
You really like it that much, huh?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes, ever since I was little. Not just the taste, but the colors too.
The green and pink are so cute!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, do you know the story behind the colors of tricolor dango?
According to one theory, pink represents spring, white is winter, and green is summer.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, having no autumn comes from
puns on "never tire of" (akinai) or "business" (akinai).

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I do love autumn too, though~.
If autumn had a color, what would it look like...?"

"Beside me, Rhein Kraft's expressions kept shifting animatedly.
Just watching her brought a warm feeling to my chest—"
choice_data_list: Outings like this are really nice...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um, what you just said...
could you say it one more time?"
choice_data_list: ...? Outings like this are nice, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Whoa... Fufu, ufufu♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ……gh, nnnnngh!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: That applies... to me as well.

We've returned to the station nearest the academy.
It should be getting dark soon.
choice_data_list: Shall we head home for today?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...S-Sorry. I'll be right—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um...! If it's all right with you...!
If it's okay, I was wondering—"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry.
It was selfish of me to ask for a detour.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ! Wait...! Just now, a star—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
A shooting star?
Trainer-san, did you see that just now?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Look, over there again!
Could this actually be a meteor shower?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, how lucky!
That's one more cherished memory for us.
choice_data_list: It turned into a day I'll never forget!
What are you going to wish on this shooting star?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Me too!
...I won't forget either.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Still, surely... today and tomorrow.
On special days, and on ordinary days as well.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I realized that every single moment
spent with you, Trainer, is unforgettable.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"No, thank you so much!
For sticking with me until the very end."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I had so much fun today... I really had a wonderful time!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, looks like we feel the same way.
Our outing was a huge success♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Um... let's see...
...What should I go with?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(...I've actually already decided,
though I might not be able to say it to their face.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(May Trainer and I continue to
share our time together like this from now on—)
